solo.name: drain succeeds when every shard keeps a replica
solo.trace:
solo check: drain succeeds when every shard keeps a replica
call: drain_node(db, node_id='A')
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT id FROM nodes WHERE id = 'A' FOR UPDATE -> [('A',)]
step 3   R1  SELECT id FROM shards WHERE id IN ( SELECT shard_id FROM replicas WHERE node_id = 'A' ) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE -> [(1,), (2,)]
step 4   R1  SELECT r1.shard_id FROM replicas r1 WHERE r1.node_id = 'A' AND r1.active = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM replicas r2 WHERE r2.shard_id = r1.shard_id AND r2.node_id != 'A' AND r2.active = true ) LIMIT 1 -> []
step 5   R1  UPDATE replicas SET active = false WHERE node_id = 'A' AND active = true -> UPDATE 2
step 6   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: every shard has at least one active replica
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT array_agg(active ORDER BY shard_id, node_id) = '{f,t,f,t}' FROM replicas
